text:
sam: Quick check — PR #67890 is blocking a canary deploy. Changes are routing fallback + auth header ordering + a small compatibility shim for legacy tokens. Need runtime + platform + security eyes. runtime: is the KV cache invalidation / shim safe on hot paths? platform: can we reserve a merge slot this afternoon? security: does header reorder affect any header-based auth? Ping @liam @anya @maria :eyes:

liam: I'll look at runtime perf impact. At a glance the shim adds one legacy token map lookup per request which might add ~0.2ms on hot path. Can you paste the diff or the shim snippet?

sam: Sure — snippet below
```diff
- handle_auth(headers)
+ normalize_auth(headers)
+ if (is_legacy(headers)) apply_shim()
```
Also this PR flips `enable_fallback_v2 = true` by default (we can change).

liam: OK. The shim does a map lookup for legacy tokens; should be fine but we need a perf check on 256-token sequences and confirm no KV eviction thrash. I'll run a quick profile and report.

anya: Platform here — canary window open 15:30–16:30 PT today. If you squash and set `rollout=canary(2%)` I can book it. Need a one-paragraph rollback plan before I lock the slot.

sam: Rollback plan (draft): revert the PR in staging, switch traffic to previous model variant, and flip `enable_fallback_v2=false` via infra flag. Abort criteria: p95 latency regression >= 10% OR auth failure rate > 0.1%. Wording ok or too strict?

maria: Security notes — header reorder appears safe but two requests: 1) add a unit test covering legacy token parsing, 2) ensure shim doesn't cause sensitive headers to be logged when it runs. Also run a basic fuzzer against auth parsing.

sam: Will add unit + fuzzer and confirm logs only contain hashed tokens. I'll attach tests before lunch.

deploy-bot: Canary slot reserved 2025-08-12T15:30:00Z for pr/67890 if merged before 2025-08-12T15:00:00Z. /deploy scheduled.

liam: Perf run complete — p95 delta ~+0.3ms on 256-token profile, CPU tail within noise, no KV thrash observed. Recommendation: proceed but ship with `enable_fallback_v2=false` initially and enable after monitoring looks stable.

anya: I can watch the canary. Please set rollout=2% and add a short auth probe (10k requests) that fails the canary if any auth-rate > 0.1%. I'll take the watch and cancel if issues.

sam: Thanks — updating PR with unit, fuzzer, and probe. Will set rollout=2% and push a new commit in ~20m. pinging @liam @anya @maria for final quick eyes when done.

maria: Thanks — I'll run a security smoke during canary and post results. :thumbsup:
